Get Transcriptome Hub statistics

fetch_transcriptome_stats.Rd

Get Transcriptome Hub statistics

Usage

fetch_transcriptome_stats()

Value

A named list with fields: total_datasets, total_organisms, total_tcm_entities, total_analysis_modules, plus distribution data.

Examples

# \donttest{
fetch_transcriptome_stats()
#> $total_datasets
#> [1] 1037
#> 
#> $total_organisms
#> [1] 54
#> 
#> $total_tcm_entities
